facts.title: UI library for React developers. - BadtzUI
facts.description: An open-source React UI library with production-ready animations. Weekly updates. Built with React, Tailwind, TypeScript & JavaScript.

research.name: BadtzUI
research.note: Animated React and Tailwind components for shadcn projects, including WebGL shader effects and a paid Pro tier of blocks.

effects: Cloud Orbit: tool icons orbiting a central avatar
Pixel Distorsion: mouse-driven pixel distortion shader on images

unverified: The components' source is public at github.com/badtzx0/badtz-ui (MIT with an additional restriction clause); research that repository instead.
